subject: Assembling November Leadership Review Packs — action items & deadlines
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Assembling November Leadership Review Packs — action items & deadlines

Team —

We need to pull together the November leadership review packs for the monthly finance/commit review. Goal is to have a clean, leadership-ready slide deck for Wednesday's consolidated review and the QBR preview next week. Key asks: 

1) Please use the attached leadership-pack-template-v2.pptx for the deck slides (one deck per manager).
2) Send me a CSV of your commit candidates with stage, expected close date, ARR, confidence level, and blockers by EOD Tuesday (Dec 1). I attached a sample column set in the template.
3) Mark any deals that should be excluded from commit (e.g., PO delay, procurement blockers) and add a one-line rationale.
4) Include any large-priority pipeline motions you want leadership to approve (discounts >15%, SLA exceptions).

Logistics: consolidated leadership review on Thursday 12/3 at 9:30am PT. I will combine manager decks into the master leadership pack by 4pm PT on 12/2. Please complete your slides + CSV by 4pm PT on 12/2.

If anything needs leadership pre-escalation before then (credits/contract language/procurement risk), flag it now and cc Finance (Kenji Sato) and Legal.

Thanks — appreciate quick turnaround on this one.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: leadership-pack-template-v2.pptx (pptx, 1.2MB)

Also: for the CSV columns, is the confidence score numeric (0-100) or the standard A/B/C classification?

- Two deals flagged for potential discount approval (Deal IDs: HD-20498, HD-20511).

Link to working leader deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_leadership_packs (I'll drop my slides in the folder this afternoon).

Quick operational note:

- Please treat the CSV that Laura sent as the canonical source for commits; managers should not create conflicting spreadsheets. If you have manual updates, add a column "manual_override" with a one-line justification.
- I attached a short commit-review-rubric.pdf with criteria for "Commit" vs "Forecasted" vs "Pipeline" — use it to standardize scoring.
- I recommend a quick manager sync tomorrow at 2pm PT to resolve open questions (15m). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Deadline reminders: manager slides + CSV by 4pm PT on 12/2, final combined pack ready 4pm PT 12/2 to circulate to leadership.

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation and final reminders before I assemble the master pack: 

- Laura: received your CSV and slides placeholder — thanks. I'll reconcile the two late tonight for any obvious data mismatches.
- Marissa / Lauren: please upload your slides to the shared drive and confirm the CSV column "commit_bucket" is present (use labels: Commit / Forecasted / Pipeline).
- If you're requesting pricing approvals >15% or SLA exceptions, add a slide called "Escalation Request" with the exact ask and the impact. CC Kenji for finance review (he's looped on this thread).
- Manager sync tomorrow at 2pm PT — I'll send a 15m invite shortly. Attendance required for any manager bringing >$250k of near-term ARR.

I'll assemble and circulate the leadership-ready combined deck by 4pm PT on 12/2. If you hit a hard blocker earlier (procurement docs, security questionnaire), flag it in the sheet and I'll escalate immediately.

Appreciate the hustle.

Jonas
